changes.title: Call or request service from any phone.
changes.text: The current site is a fixed desktop layout with a separate View on Mobile link, and the secure https address does not load. The concept puts tap to call and a service request at the top of every screen.

changes.title: Your family story and your projects up front.
changes.text: Williams and Cynthia Pace, your start in 1980 and jobs like the Studewood six story building sit at the bottom of the services page. The concept leads with them.

changes.title: Your free offers in one clear place.
changes.text: The free second opinion and the free in home estimate are spread across banners, and the homepage headline reads "years 40 of experience". The concept puts both offers in one simple request form.
